prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a parking lot collision. The patient had 4 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1287; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Nearly all findings rest on the patient's own pain reports; imaging and exam tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of right shoulder pain. Over four visits, care consisted of conservative management including rest, ice, a short course of anti-inflammatory medication, and a home stretching program. The reported injury is consistent with the mechanism and force of the crash. Treatment followed a typical course and was tapered as symptoms gradually improved. Findings during the visits relied largely on the patient's own descriptions of pain and limited motion; shoulder imaging and the orthopedic examination maneuvers performed were within normal limits. No prior injury to the right shoulder is known to this provider. Billed services reflect the visits and treatments described above, with no duplicated charges. Plan going forward is an as-needed home exercise program and follow-up if symptoms change.
